items.visual_summary: 灰色网格地面上的铜盔潜水员角色，右上角放原始参考图，左上角 HERO4 / ANIMATION REVIEW 标注从 Idle 切到 Walk，阴影与步态干净，是 Opus 在 Blender 里检查修好后的动画审片画面。
items.post_text:
ready-to-use 3D models created using tripo + claude opus 5.5 + blender...

tripo makes the model. opus checks and fixes it

the trick is never letting opus model from scratch, but there’s a smart way to set it up:

- step 1: make a 4-view reference sheet (front, back, sides) with the character in an a-pose
- step 2: generate in tripo p2.0 (~26 sec per textured asset): head, body and hair as separate parts, up to 25k quads each
- step 3: auto rig in tripo (humanoid, vrm 1.0 preset with fingers), then export glb with textures + animation on
- step 4: open it in blender, connect opus 5.5 through blender mcp and ask: “check the skeleton, weights, texture links and foot contact. don’t fix anything yet”
- step 5: let opus fix what it found: missing tail bones, hair weights, hands clipping into the body
- step 6: have opus cut it under 40k triangles and export fbx
- step 7: import into unity 6 as a humanoid rig and compare the rest pose to the original before touching animations

who does what:

- tripo p2.0: mesh, textures, rig, base animation
- opus 5.5: inspects, fixes rigs, weights and clipping, exports
- blender: the workshop where every fix happens
- unity 6: the game
- you: pick the best variant and sign off

and the rule that saves the project... most bugs live between the tools, not inside them

items.prompt:
Make a 45-second paper-collage animation of Momotaro (the Japanese folktale).

[Look]
A pop-up picture book: the book opens and paper pieces stand up one by one.
Washi paper cut-out (kirie) texture. The 3D effect comes from images and code only. Do not use any video-generation AI.

[How to build it]
1. First, write the script and show it to me (8 scenes, 4-9 seconds each; the only on-screen text is short onomatopoeia such as "donburako").
2. Once I approve the script, write the image-generation prompts:
   - one texture reference image
   - characters and backgrounds as sheets of separate paper cut-outs on transparent backgrounds
3. I will generate the images and hand them to you. Then animate them in Python:
   - make it look 3D with five tricks: depth, parallax, blur, shadows, and motion blur
   - 1920x1080, 24 fps
   - for each scene, show me 4 still frames first so I can check
4. Add narration and background music.

[Rules]
- Do not wobble or shake the pictures. Movement is only slow pushes in and pulls back.
- Don't give me English-only prompts; add an explanation in my language too.

items.title: 「用 Excel 做定格动画」制作花絮：Opus 5.5 × Excel × Blender
items.visual_summary: 绿色网格空间里分步骤卡片：Midjourney 生成下图、Kling 动起来，再把每帧拆成数千个色块在 Excel 里用自由曲线逐个画出，最后在 3D 空间中把录音机、汽水等画面碎片化重组。
items.post_text:
「Excelを、コマ撮りする」のメイキングを作ってみました。
Opus 5.5 × Excel × Blender
Excelで動画にした工程を並べてみました。

■やったこと
01 Midjourneyで下絵を生成
02 Klingで3秒の動画に
03 1コマを色の面に分けて、輪郭をとる（ソーダの1コマで2,063個）
04 その輪郭を、Excelのフリーフォームで1個ずつ描く
05 描いたものは、クリックで1個ずつ選べるただの図形
06 場面の切り替わりも、図形が欠片になって次の絵に組み変わる
07 撮ったExcelの画面を、1コマずつつなぐ
08 一部はBlenderで、Excelの絵をセルの凸凹に

■わかったこと
・トランジションが立体的になるところは味があってお気に入り
・時間がかかる
・拡大して選ぶと、ほんとにただの図形
・撮ったExcelの画面は約2,400枚。コマ撮りは根気
・やっぱり、Excelで作る必要はたぶんない
